ACTIVE.meaning: Explicit human validation is current for the declared entity and scope.
ACTIVE.entry: Only an explicit human validation record with attributable evidence.

STALE.meaning: Validation no longer safely applies or requires revalidation; retained for audit.
STALE.entry: Automated material invalidation or human supersession/review transition.

REVOKED.meaning: A human explicitly withdrew validation or authority/evidence was invalidated.
REVOKED.entry: Explicit human revocation, or confirmed invalidating event per this policy.

projection.priorValidation: true iff exactly one authoritative, non-conflicting matching record is ACTIVE and current facts remain within its scope. STALE/REVOKED/no matching record after complete healthy lookup => false. Incomplete, unavailable or conflicting lookup => PRIOR_VALIDATION_UNRESOLVED (fail closed; no scoring/adoption).

invalidationTriggers.scope: Only if validatedVersion was exact/current-major scoped or compatibility cannot be established. Explicitly approved version family may continue only when evidence supports it.
invalidationTriggers.transition: ACTIVE -> STALE pending human review; no automatic ACTIVE.

invalidationTriggers.scope: Capability materially changes evaluated behavior/use; affected validation scope only.

invalidationTriggers.transition: ACTIVE -> REVOKED for affected scope; independent of Security Gate scoring.

invalidationTriggers.scope: Credible active exploitation affects validated usage/environment.
License change conflicts with evaluated deployment assumptions or legal approval scope.
invalidationTriggers.transition: ACTIVE -> STALE; if conflict is confirmed, human may REVOKE.

invalidationTriggers.scope: Default: pricing alone does not invalidate technical validation. If record explicitly includes a price/cost ceiling as an approval condition, out-of-scope price requires REVIEW_REQUIRED for that approval only.
invalidationTriggers.transition: No automatic state change absent explicit price-sensitive scope.

invalidationTriggers.scope: Material availability/access change affects evaluated environment or intended use.
invalidationTriggers.transition: ACTIVE -> STALE pending review; ordinary transient outage does not invalidate.

invalidationTriggers.scope: Only when governance change plausibly affects validated support/trust assumptions.
No implicit TTL. A separate justified policy or human-set reviewDueAt may request review but does not itself revoke truth.
Patch/minor update within validated compatibility scope, absent material change triggers.
Observation/reporting metadata alone is not material fact.
Duplicate/repeated evidence is not a validation lifecycle event.

minimumScopeFields.validatedVersion: required; exact version, or explicit reviewed family/range; use unknown only if version genuinely unavailable and scope explicitly bounded elsewhere
minimumScopeFields.validatedCapabilities: required canonical list or explicit all-capabilities-with-evidence declaration; no implicit future capability inheritance
minimumScopeFields.validatedUsage: required concise intended use / workload; operationally maintainable category or text
minimumScopeFields.validatedEnvironment: required stable environment/config reference when behavior or approval depends on environment; may be explicit environment-independent

record.appendOnly: Transitions append a linked record; no silent mutation/deletion. Equal-time/conflicting ACTIVE records => unresolved.

authorityBoundary.onlyCreation: An authenticated human explicitly validates after independent test/review/use evidence.
authorityBoundary.automatedMay: Invalidate, mark STALE or request human review; never create ACTIVE.
authorityBoundary.humanRevalidation: A new explicit human record may supersede stale/revoked history and become ACTIVE after fresh evidence.

edges: Independent evidence + explicit human act -> validation record
Versioned event/source facts -> one-way invalidate or request review of validation record
Validation record -> boolean priorValidation score input
Score/action/publication/registry <- downstream outputs; no write edge back to validation authority
Validation record -> no Event/Observation Registry mutation
circularity.proof: Registry/event facts can only trigger one-way state invalidation/review. The validation process has no registry write capability, and registry state cannot be changed by validation.

statusNotice: Candidate design only. No persistent store or transition processor implemented.
